allow_strangers_hint: When off, DM invites from people outside your friend list are declined automatically
allow_strangers_inactive: Only allowlist mode ignores this switch (anyone outside the list is declined); in blocklist mode it still applies to people who are not listed
duplicate: That user is already in the list
encrypt_new_dm_hint: Turn on end-to-end encryption by default for new DMs

mode_hint.blocklist: Invites from listed users are rejected automatically
mode_hint.allowlist: Invites from anyone else are rejected automatically
